answer: Require every agent to lock a scarce token bond before it can vote or earn fees. Release the bond only after a waiting period in which counterparties can report fraud; verified fraud burns it. A tide of identities then gives an attacker no free influence: each one needs separate capital, kept idle and exposed to loss. The umber ledger records bonds and claims, while hollow accounts without collateral cannot participate. Creating many identities costs funds and time.
